heading: Repealed. Aug. 11, 1955, ch. 785, title I, § 110(b), 69 Stat. 662

notes.text: Section, acts June 16, 1938, ch. 98, title VI, § 66, 48 Stat. 269; Oct. 28, 1949, ch. 782, title XII, § 1201, 63 Stat. 972; Oct. 24, 1951, ch. 554, § 3, 65 Stat. 614; June 28, 1955, ch. 189, § 5, 69 Stat. 178, limited to $14,620 per annum compensation which could be paid directors, officers, or employees of banks for cooperatives, production credit corporations, and production credit associations.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Act Aug. 11, 1955, ch. 785, title I, § 112, 69 Stat. 662, provided that: “This title [repealing this section and amending section 1141f of this title] shall take effect on the first day of the month next following one hundred and twenty days after its enactment [Aug. 11, 1955].”
